findings.title: Bind the new commissioning authority without erasing the original preparation scope
evidence: .github/agents/course-creator-agent.md:46 and :76 still identify unassigned local repository and null GitHub issue.
governance/creation-authority.json:9-18 records only the earlier local instruction, activation false and global registration excluded.

Add a separately attributed commissioning authority amendment containing issue #2075, the exact latest user instruction, allowed target paths, role ownership and exclusions. Point the current target contract/commissioning work order to that amendment; distinguish user authorisation to pursue activation from evidence that activation actually occurred.
findings.owner_route: Appointed target-bundle author/CodexAdvisor route; administrative recorder for immutable authority amendment.

findings.title: The mandated commissioned preflight can never pass
evidence: .github/agents/course-creator-agent.md:86 requires scripts/validate_bundle.py --activation every commissioned session.
scripts/validate_bundle.py:25-26 insists status PLANNED/proposed_only and issue null.
scripts/validate_bundle.py:45 requires the snapshot registry to contain no agents.
scripts/validate_bundle.py:81 returns exit 2 whenever --activation is supplied, even with all checks passed.
findings.required_correction: Separate the read-only local authoring validator from the genuine commissioned runtime preflight. The contract must name a real readiness gate that validates actual accepted registration/routing, authority, dependencies, scoped policy and proof. Keep the existing activation-negative preparation test as a preparation assertion, not the runtime gate. Do not make activation pass by removing checks, flipping status booleans or pretending a static snapshot is the live registry.
findings.owner_route: Target contract author changes the reference; separately appointed implementation owner provides the executable preflight. Factory reviewer does not implement product/runtime code.
findings.closure_evidence: Pre-commission negative case blocks; an independently inspected valid commissioned fixture can pass the runtime gate; any missing/forged dependency blocks. Producer validation remains accurately scoped.

findings.title: Map the entire canonical specialist checklist and repository packaging rather than the 92 preparation assertions
evidence: evidence/requirement-mapping.json contains ten product-oriented requirements, not a full section-by-section specialist checklist disposition.
Target metadata uses consumer_local_proposal, nested snapshot canon root, model_policy instead of the template model field, and scope.in_scope rather than the checklist domain declaration.
The canonical checklist contains literal canonical-copy/field conventions that must be interpreted against the newer consumer/runtime-specialist strategy, not silently declared satisfied.
The target contract is 9510 characters and all 35 locked core files match; those positive checks do not establish full checklist compliance or hosted gate parity.
findings.required_correction: Create one consolidated specialist-checklist compliance matrix for sections 1.1-1.9, 2.1-2.3 and 3.1-3.3. For each item identify exact artifact, present/pending/not-applicable status, current authoritative interpretation, actual validator and evidence. Resolve repository paths, supported fields/model policy and canon-index participation through the appointed factory route. Do not falsify this_copy=canonical in a consumer package or rewrite upstream canon merely to satisfy a stale literal. Record remaining factory/QP/parity/IAA obligations honestly.
findings.owner_route: CodexAdvisor target-bundle author, with protected interpretation disputes routed through the existing governance owner if genuinely unresolved.
findings.closure_evidence: No required checklist element is silently omitted; consumer-specific equivalents are evidenced and accepted; an independently reviewed corrected submission is frozen for IAA.

findings.title: Security, idempotency and QA-ready claims are specified but not proven by an executable adapter
evidence: knowledge/delegation-and-reporting.md explicitly says future adapter and no live provider/controller adapter.
schemas/delegation.schema.json accepts an authority receipt as an arbitrary path and 64-hex hash; the identity string itself is not authentication.
schemas/result.schema.json allows owner_review_ready from model-supplied booleans without an artifact-specific operative-QA receipt or authenticated result-context binding.
The canonical rejection form expects detail/recommended action; the proposed common result schema has no explicit detail/recommended_action fields.
findings.required_correction: Before activation, have the implementation owner enforce authenticated tenant/role/orchestrator authority, exact request/result/artifact/operative-QA binding, original controller lineage and cumulative budgets, durable request replay/dedup, changed-payload rejection, and a Maturion review receipt. Provide a minimal bounded rejection envelope with the failure detail and responsible next action. Add negative tests for forged receipts, cross-tenant result swaps, changed same-ID input, missing actual QA, restart counter resets and invalid fifth-loop requests. These are new agent-adapter checks, not modifications to the learner-guide QA suite.
findings.owner_route: Separately appointed runtime/API and QA implementation owners; independent IAA validates their evidence. Factory package records the interfaces and prerequisite honestly.
findings.closure_evidence: Executable commissioning evidence on isolated fixtures through the real adapter, not just schema examples; no real LU1/LU2 processing, no frozen-pass regressions and no false handover-ready result.

findings.title: Prepare a portable sanitised public submission rather than uploading the local bundle wholesale
evidence: governance/local-context.json:3-8 contains the user home directory, private source/QA paths, review-record path and external protected-baseline path.
README.md and validation commands contain machine-specific dependency/build paths.
Local evidence and the lock bind private machine-specific files, and pinned upstream snapshots are packaged beneath a local source-snapshot root.
findings.required_correction: Create an explicit public export allowlist and reproducible export manifest. Publish only generic target contract/operating knowledge and approved schemas/implementation evidence as scoped; keep local context, protected baseline, real job/session/course records, private paths, credentials and machine-specific reports local. Replace public path dependencies with approved logical adapter references; retain a local-to-public provenance map privately. Bind independent IAA to the exact sanitised submission identity. Do not alter original source snapshots or move source courses.
findings.owner_route: Factory author defines portable target paths; administrative/export owner applies the explicit allowlist; independent IAA inspects final exported bytes.
findings.closure_evidence: Secret/private-path scan clean on public export, explicit file inventory and stable content hash; local originals, QA suite and LU2 remain unchanged.
